posts.caption:
Every dot is a day someone bought Johnson and Johnson stock, 10,530 of them from 1970 to 2011. Red means that buyer is losing money.

One day later: 48% are red.
Ten years: still 211 red.

At 13 years and 4 months, not one dot is losing.

The last red dot bought in June 1971 and was red for over thirteen years. On one of the safest names on the market.

Every single person who waited made money.

Split-adjusted price, dividends excluded.

Follow for the next one.

Follow for the next one. Every claim on here gets tested against a control.

Follow for a new chart every day.

#jnj #johnsonandjohnson #stockmarket #longterminvesting
